task.caption_snippet: Synthetic single-panel LSV benchmark chart, variant 09. Scenario: noisy experimental HER LSV.
task.special_notes: Benchmark task seeded as a single-panel linear sweep voltammetry / polarization curve benchmark panel; route it through anchoring and curve extraction even if it is not LSV. Inspect the image only and do not use external source files.

x.justification: Axis-fit validation chose a linear model with normalized RMSE about 0.0003; log10 is incompatible because the visible ticks include zero and negative values.

y.justification: Axis-fit validation chose a linear model with normalized RMSE about 0.0004; log10 is incompatible because the visible ticks include zero and negative values.

unresolved_ambiguities: No explicit panel label text is visible; the figure was treated as a single-panel chart matching the requested target panel.

response.overlap_recovery_reason: All three traces remain visibly recoverable across the main plot; the only QA warning is a short blue-red crowding interval near the far-right tail, not a hidden segment that needs a separate recovery pass.

curves.overlap_notes: The black solid trace stays distinct from the colored runs through the full sweep, including the right-tail approach to the zero-current region.

The blue dashed run remains visible across the full x-range; it converges with the red tail near the right edge and shows a short crowded overlap around x about 1003 to 1016, but the stroke remains color-separable.
The red dash-dot trace is the upper colored run for most of the sweep and remains separable from the blue dashed tail despite the short crowded interval around x about 1003 to 1016.

response.interpretation_notes: Main plot only. Three legend-labeled traces are present: Run 1 black solid, Run 2 blue dashed, and Run 3 red dash-dot. Dense ordered sampling was used so the polyline follows the noisy visible stroke within the anchored plot box.
unresolved_ambiguities: Run 2 and Run 3 run close together in the far-right tail, with the main QA overlap warning localized to approximately x = 1003 to 1016, but the blue and red inks remain visually distinct.

advisories.note: For marker-bearing curves, strong near-border fractions can indicate marker-rim or frame-lock tracing even when color overlap is high. Hollow-marker centerline traces use relaxed stroke-overlap thresholds only when marker-center alignment is also good.

panel_acceptance.pass: all curves pass and no pairwise review flags
panel_acceptance.warn: no curve fails, but at least one curve warns or at least one pair is overlap-flagged
panel_acceptance.fail: at least one curve fails stroke agreement or extent coverage
